crossRefs.note: I will bless those who bless you, and I will curse him who treats you with contempt. All the families of the earth will…
He couched, he lay down as a lion, as a lioness; who shall rouse him up? Everyone who blesses you is blessed. Everyone…
Yahweh your God will put all these curses on your enemies and on those who hate you, who persecuted you.
Their children also will be as before, and their congregation will be established before me. I will punish all who…
For Yahweh of Armies says: ‘For honor he has sent me to the nations which plundered you; for he who touches you touches…
He fell on the earth, and heard a voice saying to him, “Saul, Saul, why do you persecute me?”
He said, “Who are you, Lord?” The Lord said, “I am Jesus, whom you are persecuting.

translations.web: But if you indeed listen to his voice, and do all that I speak, then I will be an enemy to your enemies, and an adversary to your adversaries.
translations.bsb: But if you will listen carefully to his voice and do everything I say, I will be an enemy to your enemies and a foe to your foes.
translations.kjv: But if thou shalt indeed obey his voice, and do all that I speak; then I will be an enemy unto thine enemies, and an adversary unto thine adversaries.
translations.asv: But if thou shalt indeed hearken unto his voice, and do all that I speak; then I will be an enemy unto thine enemies, and an adversary unto thine adversaries.
